content:
Ethan (support): escalating SolarisAI (trial) ~09:40 UTC. Demo users hitting failed completions and degraded embed quality. Customer says exec demo at 11:00 PT; risk of pausing trial if not resolved. Need CS to lead comms and workaround.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-7921 - degrade in generation and embedding quality region=us-west1. Pager alerted.
Priya (csm): joining. Can support share quick repro and any visible root cause? I9ll prep a short note to Solaris execs and offer a remediation plan.
Omar (support-eng): tail from model logs:
```
[09:41:02] req=9c1a path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=22000ms resp_tokens=0 fallback=none
[09:41:18] embed_id=ef23 quality_score=0.32 input_len=512
```
We9re seeing timeouts that return empty completions, and embed scoring dropping for larger inputs. Likely memory pressure + quantization fallback causing accuracy loss.
Claire (sre): confirmed elevated host memory reclamation on pool solaris-dedicated. Autoscaler attempted scale but model load fallback triggered quantized variant with lower embed fidelity. Routing traffic to warm pool reduces errors. Implemented routing at 09:51.
Priya (csm): suggested comms draft - short + proactive. Please edit:
"Hi Solaris team - we detected degraded responses during your trial this morning. Our engineers routed your requests to a warm pool and are rolling a fix to prevent fallback to lower-precision model variants. We expect normal behavior within ~20 minutes. We9ll follow up with detail and offer a one-time trial extension and priority onboarding. - Priya, CSM"
Omar (support-eng): LGTM. Interim workaround: limit input length to 300 tokens for now and disable client-side batching for Solaris account. We can flip a per-account flag immediately.
Priya (csm): please do that and ask Solaris if they'd accept the temporary limits. Also offering 2-week extension + $300 credit? Thoughts?
Ethan (support): DMed Solaris exec: "We9ve routed you to a warm pool and applied a temporary safety limit to reduce errors. Latency and quality improving; can offer a 2-week extension + $300 credit. Would you like a quick 15m call before your demo?"
ops-bot: ALERT UPDATED: INC-7921 mitigation in progress action=route warm_pool time=09:51 region=us-west1
Claire (sre): metrics: p50 420ms, p95 1.6s, error rate down to 0.7%. Monitoring will clear if stable for 10m.
Solaris (external): "Thanks, quality looks better. Please keep the temporary limits for the demo. We'll take the 15m call at 10:30 PT."
Priya (csm): perfect. Next steps checklist for postmortem/CS notes (leaving here for record):
- collect model load traces + memory reclaim events 09:30-10:00 UTC
- per-account flags changed + approver log
- list of affected requests and customer-visible timeline
- credit/extension confirmation to include in renewal notes
- proposed long-term: increase warm pool for high-IO trials, improve quantized embed tests
Omar (support-eng): I'll attach logs and config diffs to the incident.
Ethan (support): Solaris replied: "Demo good, thanks for quick help." Closing initial thread; follow-ups in calendar invite.
Priya (csm): closing 30 adding "renewal-watch" on Solaris account until postmortem completed. Will send follow-up email and update account health doc after the call.
